I set up the calendar on the "Agenda-manifestations" dataset, set its label field to the event name, and turned on crowd sourcing. The form validates with no errors.

- **Dataset:** Agenda-manifestations.
- **Label field:** "Nom de l'évenement" (`nomevenement`), the event name column.
- **Crowd sourcing:** on.

I did not set the "Jeu de données des contributions externes" (contributions dataset) field, which appeared once crowd sourcing was on. The form is valid without it, and you didn't name a dataset for proposals. Choosing one is up to you. Without it, I can't say whether visitors' proposals will be stored anywhere. I also left the other settings at their defaults.
